atha aparam vakṣye guhya tattvam ca durlabham
utpatti sarva mantrāṇām jagat sthāvara jaṅgamam
yoginī sarva vīrāṇām buddhānām ālaya uttamam
akṣayam avyaṃyam śuddham ādi madhya anta nirmalam
tri mukham ṣaṣ bhujam śāntam tri netram karuṇā rasam
mahāmudrā samāpannam śuddham prakṛti nirmalam
jaṭā ardha candram āsīnam viśva vajra aṅkitam śiraḥ
kapāla mālā makuṭam pañcabuddhaiḥ alaṃkṛtam
sattva paryaṅkam āsīnā ṣaṣ mudrā deha bhūṣitam
vajra ghaṇṭā samāpannām asi aṅkuśa pāṇinām
sita nīla rakta vadanam tri mokṣa ālayam param
hūṃkāra citta cakram tu nīlam tad bhuja āyudhaḥ
kākāraḥ vākpatham cakram tad bhuja āyudham
oṃkāre kāya cakram tu sitam tad bhuja āyudham
ikāre tu mahāmudrā nābhi madhye vicintayet
bhaga padmam tu bodhi candra su nirmalam

original: ukāraṃ hṛdaye dhyātvā ekāraṃ śirasi nyaset |
analyzed: ukāram hṛdaye dhyātvā ekāram śirasi nyaset
aṃkāraiḥ kavacam kṛtvā aḥkāraḥ
ṛṃkāre locanā devī ṝkāre samaya tārayā
ḷkāre paṇḍarā devī ḍkāre ratna sambhūtā

original: sitā palāśavarṇā ca raktā jāmbūnadā tathā |
analyzed: sitā palāśa varṇā ca raktā jāmbūnadā tathā
tri mukhā ṣaṣ bhujāḥ ca eva tri netrā surata vihvalāḥ
digambara dharāḥ sarvāḥ

original: cakraṃ ca viśvavajraṃ ca ratnapadma tu ratnajāṃ |
analyzed: cakram ca viśvavajram ca ratnapadma tu ratnajām
ghaṇṭā saha samāpannām sarva kāma pradāyikām
asi bāṇa akuśa dharām dhanuḥ ākarṣaṇām parām
sarva alaṅkāra sampūrṇām kapāla makuṭa utkaṭām
savva paryaṅkam āsīnām viśva padma indru madhya gām

original: etā dvāreṣu vinyastā madhye candrāsanaṃ prabhum |
analyzed: etāḥ dvāreṣu vinyastāḥ madhye candrāsanam prabhum

original: koṇeṣu caturo pūjyā devyā digvāsā muktakeśikāḥ |
analyzed: koṇeṣu pūjyāḥ devyāḥ digvāsāḥ mukta keśikāḥ
tri mukhā ṣaṣ bhujāḥ ca eva tri netrā kapāla mālinī
darpaṇam ca

original: savyapāṇo [!] kare dadyād anyeṣv adhipater yathā ||
analyzed: savya pāṇo kare dadyāt anyeṣu adhipateḥ yathā
sarva alaṃkāra saṃpūrṇā vajra paryaṅka susthitī
ca eva pūjā vyagra karā tathā
evaṃvidhaḥ tu sarvajñam āli tattvam su nirmalam
bhāṣitam vajra sattvena guhyam parama durlabham
mantra tattvam ca vidhivat kāya vāc citta su saṃyutam

original: oṃ śrīmahāsukhavajrasattva āḥ a hūṃ ḍākinījālasamvara svāhā ||
analyzed: om śrī mahā sukha vajra sattva āḥ a   ḍākinī jāla samvara svāhā

om rūpa vajrī bhruṃ
om śabdavajrī hūm
om gandhavajrī khaṃ
om rasavajrī hrīṃ
bhāvayet bhaga madhya stham sarvajñam parameśvaram
āli vajram mahā guhyam sarva sattva hṛdisthitam
sarva bhāveṣu ca prakāśayet
jāpa bhāvanayā catur sandhyām ca yoginaḥ
dṛḍha vīrya mahā sattvaḥ sarva saṃtrāsa varjitaḥ
pūjā abhiṣeka samayam jñāna cakram tu paśyati
samayaḥ tu ā eka rasa bhāvena spharat saṃhāra yoga jām
traidhātukam aśeṣam ca sarva vajradhara upamām
anāgataiḥ atītaiḥ ca pratyutpanneṣu tri adhvasu
evam traiyadhvikā sattvā vajra sattva padam nyaset
sahaja ānanda śuddha ātmā anādinidhana sparam iti
abhidhāna uttarottare vajra sattva utpatti paṭalaḥ caturviṃśatitamaḥ
